steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Dance structure is how a piece is organised — the overall shape and order of sections | Key Fact: Binary form has two contrasting sections: A then B (e.g. fast then slow) | Key Fact: Ternary form has three sections: ABA — the opening section returns after a contrast | Key Fact: Rondo form alternates a main theme with different episodes: ABACADA

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from dance structure &amp; form, and one past-paper question.
